name: False Solomon's-seal
desc: False Solomon's-seal (Maianthemum racemosum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Maianthemum racemosum, the treacleberry, feathery false lily of the valley, false Solomon's seal, Solomon's plume or false spikenard, is a species of flowering plant native to North America.
